content: {"episode_id":"ep-05197","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered because the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, findings concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0), with palpitations coded as R00.2.
